ask: Vertical inspection of the remaining agent-steering prose: the skills under skills/ and the commands under commands/ ONLY — a sibling scout already covered crew/roles/, crew/guidelines/ and crew/pi/agents/ in full, so those are done and out of bounds. DO NOT fan out subagents; read the files yourself, sequentially — a previous attempt lost its fan-out to a session limit and this run is sized to be read directly. For every rule or claim that cites something checkable — a file path, file:line, CLI flag, constant, enum member, PR or issue number, a measured number — check it against this checkout and mark it true, stale, or false. Known finding to extend, not rediscover: some skills anchor evidence to /Users/x home paths that ship to nobody — sweep every skill for user-absolute paths and list each site. Check contradictions between skills (two giving different instructions for the same situation), each skill against the ratified format rules (description enumerates triggers; routing table up front; critical rules as imperatives with reason and named exception; depth in references/; posture declared), and each command against its skill (thin, names the right skill, argument-hint matches).
done_means: A per-document register covering every .md file under skills/ and commands/ — this scout reads ALL of them in full, and the register's file list proves it by count (find skills commands -name '*.md' | wc -l must equal the rows). Per file: checkable-claim count, verified true / stale / false counts, every stale or false claim quoted with the evidence. A user-absolute-path sweep table (file:line, the path, what it should cite instead). A contradictions section with both quotes. A format-compliance table, one row per skill. A commands-versus-skills table. Ranked: false first, then contradictions, then stale, then format. Every verdict carries the command or file:line that established it.
out_of_scope: No edits. No subagent fan-out — read sequentially. crew/roles/, crew/guidelines/, crew/pi/agents/ are covered by the sibling and out of bounds. No rewriting prose, no tone opinions beyond the ratified rules, no opinion on whether a skill should exist.
